params.name: pincode
params.description: Six-digit pincode required by DMart, JioMart, and Minutes.

tools.name: delivery_eta
tools.description: Get delivery ETA and store availability for one platform. Required: latitude, longitude, platform. Optional: pincode. Returns the DeliveryETA.

params.name: pincode
params.description: Six-digit pincode required by DMart, JioMart, and Minutes.

tools.name: items_get
tools.description: Get live price, stock, and availability for an item ID. Required: item-id, latitude, longitude, platform. Optional: pincode. Returns array of Item.

params.name: platform

params.name: pincode
params.description: Six-digit pincode required by DMart, JioMart, and Minutes.

params.name: query
